scope: Only the same 100 Annex1 samples and their 37 source videos. No emotion values, extra training samples, fitting or threshold selection from public emotion labels.
frozen_outputs: Q1 v6 primary arrays; evaluate before any proposed change
anchor: independent waveform normalized cross-correlation: coarse 4000Hz, refine 16000Hz; no word timestamps used
words: Strict primary cohort: unique exact normalized transcript subsequence, verified waveform anchor, positive public word intervals wholly within decoded local audio. Report both every eligible word and current supported subset, plus all exclusions. Partial-text matches descriptive only.
word_metrics: absolute start/end difference median, MAE, p95
source-video clustered bootstrap 95% interval using seed 20260924 and 2000 repeats
audio: Same physical quantities only: pYIN F0 vs COVAREP F0 (Hz) and voicing, using independent waveform origin and nearest public frame within 15ms. Report pitch semitone differences on jointly voiced frames and denominator/voicing agreement. No direct equality claimed for different feature families.
interpretation: P2FA/COVAREP are external processing references, not infallible truth; differences trigger source-signal investigation, not automatic replacement. Report masked failures and coverage, not just accepted cases.
